title: Insulin action times

findings.where: Images 8 and 16, step "worked": NPH trace over the shaded peak window; insulin.jsx worked curve and area fills
findings.title: Overlapping fills reduce essential curve contrast below the project requirement
findings.problem: Using the supplied theme tokens, the dark-theme teal trace has approximately 3.9:1 contrast against the amber window, falling to about 3.0:1 against the combined amber and teal fills. The corresponding light-theme filled overlap is about 3.5:1. This essential teaching curve fails the project's ≥4.5:1 requirement.
findings.fix: Use the higher-contrast accent ink for curve strokes and matching legend samples, or add a contrasting outline that preserves each dash pattern. Check contrast against the composited backgrounds, not just the card background.

assessment: Fix the worked-example curve contrast before publication.
